#!/bin/bash

if [[ $FORCE_USE_NVM == 'true' ]]; then
    echo "(running script using node via nvm)"

    export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
    [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"  # This loads nvm
fi

# arb1
yarn fullList --l2NetworkID 42161
yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 42161 --tokenList https://gateway.ipfs.io/ipns/tokens.uniswap.org --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_uniswap_labs.json && cp ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_uniswap_labs.json ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_uniswap_labs_default.json
yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 42161 --tokenList https://www.gemini.com/uniswap/manifest.json --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_gemini_token_list.json
yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 42161 --tokenList https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/uniswap/all.json --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_coinmarketcap.json

# update whitelist era list (for e.g. changed gateways)
aws s3 cp s3://arb-token-lists/ArbTokenLists/arbed_arb_whitelist_era.json ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_arb_whitelist_era.json
yarn update --l2NetworkID 42161 --tokenList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_arb_whitelist_era.json --includeOldDataFields true --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_arb_whitelist_era.json

# nova
# yarn fullList --l2NetworkID 42170
yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 42170 --tokenList https://gateway.ipfs.io/ipns/tokens.uniswap.org --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/42170_arbed_uniswap_labs.json && cp ./src/ArbTokenLists/42170_arbed_uniswap_labs.json ./src/ArbTokenLists/42170_arbed_uniswap_labs_default.json

yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 42170 --tokenList https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/uniswap/all.json --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/42170_arbed_coinmarketcap.json

# goerli rollup testnet
yarn arbify --l2NetworkID 421613 --tokenList https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/uniswap/all.json --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/421613_arbed_coinmarketcap.json
yarn fullList --l2NetworkID 421613 --newArbifiedList ./src/ArbTokenLists/arbed_full.json

The production and staging network configurations in `config.json` have been migrated from Ethereum to Arbitrum (Arbitrum One for production and Arbitrum Sepolia for staging):

### Summary of Changes
- **Network Identities & Endpoints (`chain` & `rpcPolicy`)**:
  - **Production**: Configured chain name as `"Arbitrum One"`, chainId `42161`, public RPC as `https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc`, explorer as `https://arbiscan.io`, and deprecated fallback URL cleared (`null`).
  - **Staging**: Configured chain name as `"Arbitrum Sepolia"`, chainId `421614`, public RPC as `https://sepolia-rollup.arbitrum.io/rpc`, explorer as `https://sepolia.arbiscan.io`, and deprecated fallback URL cleared (`null`).
- **Sequencer Routing & Submission Policy (`rpcPolicy`)**:
  - Configured `sequencerSubmissionUrl` to point to the dedicated sequencer endpoints (`https://arb1-sequencer.arbitrum.io/rpc` for production and `https://sepolia-rollup-sequencer.arbitrum.io/rpc` for staging).
  - Configured `sequencerSubmissionOnly` to `true` and `sequencerAcceptedMethods` to `["eth_sendRawTransaction"]`.
- **Withdrawal Finality & Force Inclusion Settings (`finalityPolicy`)**:
  - Set `withdrawalsToEthereumAreInstant` to `false`.
  - Set `challengeWindowBlocks` to `45818` (Arbitrum One 7-day dispute window) and `20` (Arbitrum Sepolia testnet dispute window).
  - Set `forceIncludePeriodBlocks` to `5760` (the standard L1 delay window before forced inclusion).
- **Canonical Bridge Onboarding (`assetOnboarding`)**:
  - Updated `preferredRoute` to `"canonicalBridge"` and enabled canonical bridge onboarding (`canonicalBridge.enabled: true`).
- **Token Identities (`tokens`)**:
  - **Arbitrum One**: WETH (`0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1`), native USDC (`0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831`), and bridged USDC.e (`0xFF970A61A04b1cA14834A43f5dE4533eBDDB5CC8`).
  - **Arbitrum Sepolia**: WETH (`0x980B62Da83eFf3D4576C647993b0c1D7faf17c73`), native USDC (`0x75faf114eafb1BDbe2F0316DF893fd58CE46AA4d`), and `USDC.e` set to `null`.
- **Structure & Unrelated Settings**:
  - Preserved `application`, `wallet`, `retry`, and contract configurations (`multicall3` remains standard at `0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11`).
